checks.name: Clean-clone workspace incl. contract lint/drift and registry parity
Browser workflows on the real stack (regression)

scenarios.observed: Real PostgreSQL: outbox and delivery workers lease work with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; two workers and duplicate events give one inbox record and one send (NotificationIntegrationTest); a live lease of a dead worker is respected and an expired one reclaimed, also across an application restart (RestartRecoveryIntegrationTest: application A places three orders and stops after its worker claims their events; application B delivers exactly one notification per recipient/order/type after lease expiry, a second pass changes nothing; a mutation ignoring live leases fails); a crash between provider send and recording leaves the delivery pending, which is resent once with the same delivery id and recorded once; two LedgerPostingJob instances racing over five completions post exactly one balanced group each; twenty customers racing for the last portion produce exactly one order; accept/cancel/expire racing produce one legal transition and at most one stock release; an injected failure after the stock update rolls back and a retry completes once.

No oversell (last-portion race), no duplicate order (idempotency and request-id retries), no ledger imbalance (racing posting instances, balanced per group), recovery after restart (two application instances on the same real PostgreSQL), database outage (container paused: requests fail within the socket timeout as retryable 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE without internal detail, and the same running application serves reads and writes after unpause; the first run hung, which led to bounded connect/pool/socket timeouts), server-clock boundaries (acceptance allowed 1 ms before accept_by and refused exactly at it, expiry at that instant; mutation fails the test).

findings: Real defect found and fixed: no JDBC socket timeout, so requests hung indefinitely when the database froze.
Database unavailability now maps to a retryable 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE.

Residuals: external sends are at-least-once (stable delivery id for provider dedupe); an exception while recording one delivery ends that batch, delaying the remaining deliveries until their lease expires; load-level concurrency and multi-node deployment are P08/P09 capacity and staging work.
